web_title: 9. Both Sides of the Aisle, Likely Outcomes & No-FOMO Action Plan
book_title: Chapter 9: Bull vs. Bear, Likely Outcomes & Our Action Plan
question: What is our unbiased probability-weighted judgment, exact new-capital verdict, holding action, and 100% capital redeployment plan?

epigraph.quote: The best investors do not predict the future; they weigh the base rates, wait for asymmetric odds, and size their bets so a single wrong call never breaks the portfolio.
epigraph.author: Institutional Portfolio Desk

web_blocks.html: The Bull Steelman: IGIL sets the global standard in jewelry's fastest-growing category, holding ~65% global LGD certification share. GIA's October 2025 retreat from granular LGD 4Cs grading has widened IGIL's moat [3][9][10]. The business operates 36 labs, earns 69.2% ROCE and ~60% operating margins, and holds net cash. Q2 FY27 volume jumped +26% YoY, prompting management to raise FY27 revenue growth guidance to 27%+. IGIL can compound earnings at 20%+ annually while expanding into prestige colored stones via AGL [1][4][5][8].

The Bear Steelman: Lab-grown diamond wholesale prices have fallen sharply. That drop creates steady pressure from Surat cutters for volume rebates and batch pricing. Meanwhile, debtor days crept from 47 to 66 through March 2026, even though Q2 FY27 released ₹662M. Promoter Blackstone (76.55% stake) must also sell below 75% before December 2027 under SEBI MPS rules, adding guaranteed secondary supply [1][4][14]. At ₹438.90 (RSI 79.69, +27.5% above the 200-DMA), any minor ASP slip or block deal could trigger a 15%–22% pullback toward ₹345–₹375 [17][22].

Multi-Horizon Judgment:
• Short-Term Trading / Momentum (1–12 weeks): Pass / Do Not Chase. Daily RSI 79.69 and a +38.3% one-month gain leave zero short-term edge. Wait for a 10W EMA or 20-DMA pullback.
• Medium-Term Inflection (3–12 months): Constructive on Pullback (WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT). Post-GIA share gains and 27%+ FY27 guidance drive strong earnings momentum. Capture it in the ₹375–₹395 zone.
• Long-Term Compounding (2–5 years): TIER_2 Core Compounder. IGIL is an asset-light 69.2% ROCE tollbooth with net cash and global LGD and jewelry tailwinds. Accumulate on pullbacks or post-Blackstone block dips.

Per the same-session Zerodha IN positions ledger on November 13, 2026, total net worth is ₹42.97 lakh (₹37.23 lakh in 18 equities plus ₹5.75 lakh cash). IGIL is NOT HELD (0 shares, ₹0 market value, 0.0% portfolio weight) [23]. Accordingly, Holding Action = NOT_HELD and Shares to Sell = 0. No existing position needs trimming or stop-loss action. The alerts below govern disciplined new-capital entry.

web_blocks.html: Why Cash Wins Today: Retaining 100% of marginal capital in INR cash (₹5,74,582 pool) beats forcing an immediate equity buy. At ₹438.90 and RSI 79.69, IGIL offers only 0.82:1 asymmetry to our ₹520.00 base target [17, 22]. Waiting for ₹375–₹395 improves that reward-to-risk ratio to 2.27:1. Active shortlist name Coforge (₹2,028.00, RSI 56.94) offers 1.81:1 asymmetry, while outside peer CRISIL (₹4,352.40) trades at 35.5x P/E with 32.6% ROCE and weak RSI 39.44. Neither matches IGIL's 69.2% ROCE and 27%+ guided growth once the chart cools.

Thesis Invalidation Watchlist: We would downgrade IGIL from COMPOUNDER_PASS and exit any open position if any of four breaks occur. First, implied revenue per report falls >10% YoY for two straight quarters due to LGD fee cuts. Second, debtor days exceed 75 days without seasonal collection recovery. Third, EBITDA margins break structurally below 48%. Fourth, the stock closes below the ₹340.00 Stage 2 floor on heavy volume.

Execution Checklist for Staged Deployment: First, place GTT price alerts at ₹395.00 (upper shelf) and ₹378.00 (10-week EMA core). Second, confirm Daily RSI(14) resets below 58 on lighter pullback volume. Third, cap risk at 1.0% of portfolio (₹42,975 max loss on ₹42.97L net worth). That equals ~781 shares at a ₹395 entry with a ₹340 stop, capped at ~₹2.5L–₹3.0L notional by position limits. Fourth, honor ₹340.00 as a hard daily-close stop-loss.

IGIL shows the core discipline of this desk. Separate business underwriting from price action, demand asymmetric odds when a Tier-2 compounder runs hot, and let cash wait for the ₹375–₹395 support shelf [17][22].
Action Trigger (New Capital & Stop): Enter Tier-2 Core Alpha tranche only on a pullback into ₹375.00–₹395.00 with Daily RSI cooling below 58. Enforce a hard daily-close stop at ₹340.00.

book_paragraphs: We have walked through fifty years of gemological history, four distinct profit engines, a ₹100 cash-flow waterfall that converts a third of revenue into free cash, a Reverse DCF, and a Stage 2 chart stretched to a daily RSI of nearly 80. Now it is time to put our chips on the table—clearly, decisively, and without hedging.

On business quality, IGIL earns a clear Compounder Pass. It is a debt-free, 69%-ROCE certification toll-booth whose moat just widened after GIA stepped away from granular lab-grown 4Cs grading. Yet on timing, chasing ₹438.90 after a 38% one-month sprint violates every rule of asymmetric risk management. Our New-Capital Verdict is WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT: let the stock pull back into the ₹375–₹395 support shelf (anchored to the 10-week EMA and 20-day SMA), with a hard invalidation stop at ₹340.00 and a 12–18 month base target of ₹520.00—delivering a clean 2.27-to-1 reward-to-risk ratio.

book_subsections.title: Exact Execution Triggers & Capital Redeployment
paragraphs: First, let us verify your actual ledger: as of November 13, 2026, your Zerodha portfolio holds zero shares of IGIL (₹37.23 lakh invested across 18 stocks, plus ₹5.75 lakh in cash). So our holding action is NOT_HELD with zero shares to sell.

Second, where should the next marginal ₹1,00,000 of cash go today? It stays 100% in Cash. We benchmarked active shortlist name Coforge (constructive at ₹2,028, RSI 56.94) and outside asset-light peer CRISIL (35.5x P/E, 32.6% ROCE, RSI 39.44). Neither matches the combination of IGIL's 69.2% ROCE and 27%+ guided growth once IGIL cools off. Set your GTT alert between ₹375 and ₹395, keep your ₹340 stop non-negotiable, and let the market come to you.

callouts.title: NARRATOR'S REFLECTION: PATIENCE IS AN ACTIVE POSITION
callouts.text: Holding 100% cash while waiting for a Tier-2 compounder to pull back 10%–14% from RSI 79.69 is not indecision—it is the exact discipline that turns a 0.82:1 gamble into a 2.27:1 institutional trade.

book_subsections.title: What Would Change Our Mind
paragraphs: Every sound investment thesis must carry its own kill-switch. For IGIL, two fundamental red flags would force us to walk away regardless of the chart: first, a sustained drop in revenue per report of more than 10% year-on-year for two straight quarters, which would prove that wholesale LGD deflation has finally breached IGIL's rate-card moat; and second, a jump in debtor days past 75 days, which would signal that growth is being bought on loose credit.

Absent those breaks, our game plan is crystal clear. Do not chase ₹438.90 at an RSI of 79.69. Keep your marginal cash in reserve, set alerts for the ₹375–₹395 support shelf, size each tranche strictly at 1% portfolio risk against a ₹340.00 hard stop, and let a 69%-ROCE global toll-booth compound on your side of the trade.

book_subsections.title: Translating Conviction Into Position Sizing
paragraphs: Notice how we size a position in the real world: we never start with 'how much money do I feel like putting in?' We start with 'how much of my ₹42.97 lakh portfolio am I willing to lose if I am completely wrong?' At a 1% portfolio risk budget, your maximum acceptable loss is ₹42,975. Dividing ₹42,975 by the ₹55 per-share risk between a ₹395 entry and a ₹340 stop gives a risk-budgeted ceiling—which you then temper with prudent single-stock position caps (typically 6% to 8% of portfolio value on an initial tranche).

By keeping 100% of your marginal ₹1,00,000 cash unit in reserve today rather than forcing an entry at ₹438.90, you preserve both dry powder and emotional composure. Let the stock cool off from RSI 79.69, step in at support with 2.27-to-1 odds in your favor, and let IGIL's 69% ROCE do the heavy lifting from there.

book_subsections.title: Closing Word: Discipline Over Impulse
paragraphs: As we wrap up this dossier, remember why we built it in two separate halves. In the first half, completely blind to the share price, we discovered an extraordinary asset-light global toll-booth with 69% ROCE, rising market share after GIA's October 2025 shift, and clean cash flows. In the second half, we opened the chart and saw a stock that had already sprinted 38% in a month to an RSI of nearly 80.

Great investing lives in the tension between those two truths. You do not abandon a great business just because it is extended, and you do not chase an extended chart just because the business is great. Keep your 100% marginal cash ready, set your alerts at ₹375 to ₹395, honor your ₹340 stop, and let patience pay you.
